A.name: Ground truth provenance and coverage
details: Identity and camera labels come from RGBNT100 filenames via the dataset loader; training labels alone are relabelled to 0..49. Official query/gallery labels remain original IDs. The AV path uses full_records(), not the dormant identity-heldout split_records() path.

Independently parsed every row in both archived manifests: 8,675 training records/50 IDs, 1,715 queries/50 IDs, 8,575 gallery records/50 IDs; train/test IDs disjoint; each split has cameras 0..7; all filenames unique within each split. Both raw archives and state archives carry the exact manifest names, IDs, cameras and scenes. Every query has 50..175 legal positives and exactly 8,550 retained gallery records after removing 25 same-ID/same-camera records.

All 6,563 formal batches per AV control use eligible training names, collectively visit all 8,675 records, and have real-update flags with no AMP skips. The train-only hard-neighbor bank metadata exactly equals the training manifest and contains only the 50 relabelled training identities; it records zero query/gallery forwards.

Teacher output and cached-feature equality are consistency evidence. Neither supplies the identity/camera GT used to compute retrieval metrics. The O contribution target is a detached model-margin training proxy with train-label-based positive/negative indices.
claim_limits: PASS covers the archived official-split provenance and complete saved coverage. Current remote image directories were not re-enumerated because SSH/collector execution is prohibited; the existing installed-filename audit and its archived child exit are supporting historical witnesses, not a fresh remote verification.
Eight state cases repeat the same 1,715 queries; they are not 13,720 independent samples.

B.name: Score normalization
details: AP averages precision at true-positive ranks after the legal exclusion; INP divides the true relevant count by the last true-positive rank; CMC is a proportion of valid queries. Multiplication by 100 is a fixed percentage conversion. No metric divides by the model maximum, mean, norm or other prediction-derived performance denominator.

L2-normalized features, AS projected-query normalization, temperature-2 routing and the 0.10 descriptor-shift bound are explicit representation/training choices. They are not metric-score normalization. Raw distances remain archived.

A separate stdlib-only auditor ranked all 10 saved matrices (two selected-normal and eight state matrices; 17,150 per-query recounts) with stable gallery-index tie-breaking, then matched six metrics, all CMC1..50 entries, every per-query field and every identity/camera/scene group. Largest observed six-metric aggregate difference was 2.1316282072803006e-14 percentage points.
claim_limits: The independent recount verifies the saved ranking/GT arithmetic. It does not rerun the network or recompute every pairwise feature dot product.
Weight/gradient norms, route entropy and counterfactual old-L2 magnitudes do not demonstrate identity relevance or a causal decay mechanism.

Earliest maximum-mAP checkpoint selection was independently checked against all 50 epoch rows for every one of the 13 normal table entries. Independently verified all 13 normal rows against source per-query CSVs/results, 10 comparisons, 17,150 paired-query rows, 767 group rows, 8 state rows, 6 state comparisons, 100 AV epoch curves, 1,500 QKV curve rows and 200 frequency-value curve rows. D.name: Active scorer and output reachability
details: The actual AV __main__ imports run_full_official_frozen_anchor_experiment, installs the AV optimizer and explicitly binds the inherited configuration, frozen-anchor assertion, metadata writer and hard-sampling loader. The direct source chain was traced through AS/AQ/AL/AG/AD/AC/X/W/S/P/O/N/M/K/I/G; the effective step reaches run_r201g_normal_priority.step and its single unscale/Adam step after two backwards.

The effective training loop calls evaluate every epoch and after the selected checkpoint reload. evaluate calls full_evaluation.full_metrics; full_metrics independently cross-checks utils.reid_evaluation.evaluate_reid and writes per-query JSON/CSV. The state entry similarly calls full_metrics plus installed_rows/recount/verify. Actual epoch/per-query/raw outputs match that path.

Legacy full_evaluation.main (heldout-development workflow), audit_full_official49.main and utils.metrics wrapper/visualization paths are not the AV entry points. Their existence is not evidence of AV heldout evaluation, missing-49 evaluation, reranking or a new similarity metric. No reported AV metric originates from an uncalled scorer.
claim_limits: Reachability was established by reading the active local sources and matching saved outputs, without importing project modules or launching any entry point.
Uncalled legacy helpers are not silently treated as tested functionality or reported AV results.

E.name: Scope, budget, selection and resource claims
details: The new AV evidence is one dataset (RGBNT100), one seed (42), two matched controls, 50 new epochs and 6,563 formal updates each, plus three native updates each: 100 new formal model-epochs, 13,126 formal updates and six native updates. A previously trained original DeMo50 epoch-8 teacher is reused. Per AV model the training lineage is teacher50 plus new50; the original reference has 50 epochs. The 13-row table includes 11 historical rows and only two new AV models.

All 50 official query/gallery evaluations select the maximum mAP checkpoint, with earliest ties. The original teacher was also benchmark-selected, and multiple historical variants have been examined on the same benchmark. These are development/benchmark-selected comparisons, not an untouched final test, multi-seed confirmation or a broad generalization result.

Whole normal AV-axis versus original, matched ordinary and AS comparisons are retained, including negative cases. Axis improves over AS by +0.23709305233175826 mAP/+0.5247813411078681 Rank-1 pp; ordinary decreases versus AS by -0.03366462033437756/-0.2332361516034922 pp. Axis versus matched AV ordinary is only +0.18590570553793384/+0.2915451895043617 pp. Final epoch axis mAP/Rank-1 is 85.79570154190885/96.3265306122449; ordinary final is 85.72686189156894/96.44314868804665. Small selected-score increases do not establish reliable or universal benefit.

Each fixed selected checkpoint has four normal-input states 00/10/01/11, with no retraining between interventions. No AV missing-modality six-setting result, new49 result, RGBNT201 result or MSVR310 result is established by this audit.

The recorded end_to_end_seconds values (axis 91.79868245124817; ordinary 88.8834056854248) time selected feature extraction over 10,290 records, including decode/first batch/synchronization. The timer stops before CPU distance computation and metric reduction, and does not include model/checkpoint setup. peak_memory (axis 1,437,281,792; ordinary 1,665,325,568 bytes) is the process maximum without a per-phase reset. Whole run elapsed times include training, periodic benchmark evaluation, serialization and final extraction. None is an isolated training-only or inference-only cost comparison.
claim_limits: Use the phrase single-seed benchmark-selected normal-input controlled result. Do not claim simultaneous +1 acceptance, robust generalization, a new mechanism, causal decay repair or missing-modality success.
State interventions are frozen diagnostic ablations, not retrained component ablations. Query repeats do not provide independent replications.
The disclosed resource numbers must retain their measurement boundaries; they do not establish deployable latency, isolated inference memory or end-to-end system speedups.

F.name: Evaluation classification and fixed-state oracle
details: The selected normal metrics and each 00/10/01/11 state use real dataset GT: real_gt. A frozen state may be diagnostic in scope while its retrieval correctness is still measured against real GT.

Strict reload, teacher/base equality, unchanged tensor versions and normal/cache equality are deterministic consistency checks against model-produced references: synthetic_proxy/consistency evidence, not independent identity GT. Detached contribution-margin targets and counterfactual old-L2 magnitudes are training diagnostics, not benchmark accuracy or causal ground truth.

The additional fixed_four_state_Rank1_union_CPU.json is a correctly labelled real-GT oracle diagnostic over the four existing homogeneous query/gallery-state rankings. I independently checked its entire per-state rescue sets from all state CSVs and against the raw-array recount. Original/state00 has 58 errors. States10 and01 rescue none of those errors in either control. Ordinary state11 rescues only query210; its four-state union maximum is 1658/1715=96.67638483965014%. Axis state11 rescues queries162,163,185,588,596,701,704,1682,1683; its union maximum is 1666/1715=97.14285714285714%.

Reaching original Rank-1 plus one percentage point requires at least18 extra correct queries (1675 total). Even perfect selection among these existing four states and perfect avoidance of their harms still leaves ordinary17 and axis9 additional successes missing. This calculation uses test GT to choose a state and is not a deployable selector.
